name: Tailwind CSS CDN
summary: CDN that serves the Tailwind CSS browser script for pinned versions from 3.0.0 through 3.4.17.
description: A CDN endpoint for Tailwind CSS: requesting a version path such as /3.4.17 returns that build as a JavaScript file, and the root URL redirects to the newest version. Unknown paths return a console.error that lists every available version, from 3.0.0 through 3.4.17.
contains: serves Tailwind CSS browser builds by version path
root redirects to the latest build, 3.4.17
versions from 3.0.0 through 3.4.17, including 3.0.0 alpha releases
unknown paths return a console.error listing the available versions
